items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got six of them I feed around here. Meow, Minnie, Ginny, Sally, Tom, and Willie.

ctx.x: Of course you mean cats, right?
Yeah, sure, pussycats. Little cats. I got six of them I feed around here. Meow, Minnie, Ginny, Sally, Tom, and Willie.
That little grey one that’s running out there. I think we can wrap up for today.
